== Acquisition ==
'''[[Signet of Capture]]'''
* [[Nehjab the Parched]] ([[Poisoned Outcrops]])

== Notes ==
* This skill will destroy any spirit(s) you control so long as they are within party range.
* Heroes seem to use this skill when you cast a spirit as well.
* Consider using [[Ritual Lord]], [[Soul Twisting]] or [[Spirit Channeling]] instead of this skill if using 12+ ranks in Spawning Power. 
** These skills provide superior energy-management, a faster recharge bonus, do not require pre-existing spirits to function at full potential and they do not destroy spirits.

== Trivia ==
* The functionality of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[/Skill history|skill revision history]] for details.
